caption: This drawing depicts a piece of beige or off-white fabric with embroidered decorations arranged in two horizontal sections. The composition features various botanical elements, including multiple types of flowers, leaves, and stems, rendered in a variety of colors such as shades of pink, red, yellow, green, and blue. The flowers have different forms, some resembling tulips, daisies, carnations, and other blossoms, with petals in hues of red, pink, yellow, or blue. The leaves are largely green or blue-green, with some yellow tints, and are scattered throughout the design in different shapes and sizes. Small blue and yellow buds, as well as seed pods, are interspersed among the larger florals. The embroidery outlines and fills in these shapes with visible threads, contributing to the overall visual texture. The fabric is mildly wrinkled and unhemmed along the edges, with a seam running horizontally near its center, dividing the upper and lower panels, both of which continue the floral motif. The overall composition is loosely organized, giving space between individual floral and botanical elements, which are distributed fairly evenly across the cloth.
title: Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
